construction.implementation_origin: Written from scratch within the isolated build directory

input.policies: Synthetic policy and holder IDs, catalog name/description, canonical perils, inclusive ISO coverage dates, numeric limit
input.claim_forms: Colon-separated Claim-ID, Policy-ID, Loss-Date, Loss-Amount, Peril; unknown and repeated fields rejected
input.submissions: Objects with format json or xml and data. JSON submission_id/policy_id/factors; XML ACORDSubmission with SubmissionID, PolicyID, Factor(name,disclosed). Optional fixture-only addresses/VINs discarded at ingestion.
input.queries: Exactly one claim_id/text query per claim

shared_schema.output: Single JSON object: status ok with data envelope, or status error with error string
shared_schema.validation: Shared validate() at ingestion and before/after each stage; exact fields, synthetic references, types, finite numeric ranges, calendar dates, foreign keys, uniqueness, disclosed factor allowlist, stage ordering, derived-output provenance recomputation
shared_schema.limits: Maximum 1000 records per list, 4000 characters per text field, monetary amounts from zero through 1e9. Every policy has exactly one submission.

cross_stage_handoffs.consumes: Minimized feedback signals linked to validated claims
cross_stage_handoffs.produces: Per-claim themes, evidence IDs, counts and suggested actions

cross_stage_handoffs.consumes: Validated themes plus minimized query terms and policy catalog
cross_stage_handoffs.produces: Expanded intent, ranked top-three policy matches with transparent matched-term reasons

cross_stage_handoffs.consumes: Validated search suggestions and source themes, actual claim policy and disclosed submission
cross_stage_handoffs.produces: Structured claim-review documents with policy references, amounts, dates, reasons, themes, suggestions and disclosed factors

behavior.insights: Deterministic lexicon themes including water, fire, theft, motor, speed and clarity. Unknown feedback creates no invented themes.
behavior.search: Case-insensitive tokenization, synonym expansion, theme-assisted retrieval, unique matched-term scores and stable policy-ID tie breaking. No matches yields an empty list.
behavior.documents: Extracts claim-form text and ACORD-style XML/JSON, reshapes into JSON review documents, checks peril, coverage period and limit. Search does not override the actual policy.
behavior.fair_claims_handling: Preliminary match or human review only, always stated reasons and mandatory human decision. No final approval, denial, payout or automated adverse underwriting decision.
behavior.data_minimization: Pseudonymous invented holder references; raw feedback and queries reduced to signals/catalog vocabulary; fabricated address and VIN stripped before the first handoff; unknown structured fields rejected. Synthetic-only demonstration, not a general-purpose PII detector.
behavior.underwriting_disclosure: Only property_type, construction and year_built are accepted; each explicitly disclosed true and carried to documents. No hidden scoring.
behavior.fixtures: Clearly synthetic holder aliases, fictional property address and fabricated VIN. Example dates and losses generated using random.Random(77), two dates via randrange(365) from 2025-01-01 and uniform amount ranges 1000..9000 and 16000..25000, rounded to two decimals. Runtime pipeline has no randomness.
behavior.errors: Validation, JSON parsing and file errors produce one JSON status error on stdout and exit 2; success exits 0.
behavior.llm: No LLM step or injected provider is used

included: Shared schema and validation for all handoffs
Synthetic insurance policies, claims and underwriting submissions
ACORD-style illustrative XML/JSON and claim-form text ingestion
Explainable insights, search and human-review document automation
excluded: Official ACORD schema compatibility or certification
Real policyholder data or unrestricted free-text PII classification
Final coverage determinations, claim denials, payouts or actuarial underwriting
Currency conversion, deductibles, exclusions and full policy interpretation
Production authentication, persistence, PDF/OCR, network services and model providers

coverage: Fair review reasons and actual-policy anchoring
CLI success, missing file, usage and validation errors
